front.title: Merkle Tree Agent Certificates (MTAC): A Merkle Tree Certificates Profile for AI Agent Identity

abstract.t:
This document profiles Merkle Tree Certificates (MTC) for the identity of AI agents. An MTAC certificate is an MTC whose subject is one AI agent instance, named by a workload identifier in a URI subject alternative name, so that it is also a Workload Identity Certificate. It carries a mandatory non-critical extension naming the sponsor the CA recorded as accountable for the agent, and two optional ones: scopes declared for the agent at issuance, and the model and configuration components the agent is issued for, each graded by how the CA came to record it.
The document also defines an audit cosigner role and a procedure by which an auditor, possibly without network access and possibly long after issuance, can establish that a certificate was issued and logged and what it declared.
An MTAC certificate identifies an agent. It does not authorize the agent to do anything, and it does not record what the agent did. Records of agent actions can be expressed as signed statements in a transparency service that refer to an MTAC certificate as the acting party.
